segments.text:
V. 1.
In thoſe days—that is, while Jeſus dwelt there. In the wilderneſs of Judea—This was a Wilderneſs properly ſo called, a wild, barren, deſolate Place, as was that alſo where our LORD wa• tempted. But generally ſpeaking, a Wilderneſs in the New Teſtament, means only a Common, or leſs cultivated Place, in Oppoſition to Paſture and Arable Land.
